'''Poison spiders''' are monsters which can be found in many locations, including the [[Wilderness]]. There is a chance to find one when opening a chest in the [[Observatory Dungeon]].

They have little to no [[drops]] (other than [[charms]]), aggressively attack with ranged and are fairly accurately able to [[poison]]. They can poison for up to around 300 per hit, lasting for 3 minutes. Therefore, they are generally considered nuisances, such as in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]], while killing [[black demon]]s or in battle against [[Chronozon]] during [[Family Crest]].

Their attacks cause poison only if they inflict damage. They usually land a successful hit in the first 2 attacks if the player is not wearing good armour or has a low [[Defence]] level. The presence of these creatures generally forces players to bring anti-poison methods, wasting a slot which could have been used for other useful supplies. These monsters are not aggressive to players with a combat level of 107 or greater, except in the [[Wilderness]].
